_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: THE MEMBER VISUAL RESET, AS A SMOKE CANDIDATE. Owner-requested checkpoint promotion so the member app can be exercised on staging more often instead of waiting for a long branch to finish. Carries the five-slot member shell (Home, Community, raised MOVE, Progress, You) and five implemented member pages: Home, MOVE/contribution, Community, Progress (Phase A) and the current Page 5 / You implementation. YOU IS NOT ACCEPTED. Page 5 was built to a reviewed and accepted target, but its actual Before -> After visual acceptance is still OPEN on PR #365. It is on staging to be smoke-tested, not because it passed a visual gate, and being served here does not advance that decision. Frontend only: no function code, no rules, no indexes, no IAM and no mail configuration.

_uiOnlyPromotionNote: 7e788a911422d83a10da3deceb41ee49f6167734 is 52 commits above 6b257c398737e88ff399ba132166533ff3504523, the SHA this file previously approved. Measured against THAT sha and re-derived for this pin, not carried over from the previous note: functions-westayfit/, .github/, functions/ and apps/goarrive/ are IDENTICAL tree objects, and firestore.rules, firestore.indexes.json, firebase.json, firebase.westayfit.json, firebase.westayfit.emulators.json and .firebaserc are IDENTICAL blobs. ONE CORRECTION TO THE DIRECTION THAT REQUESTED THIS PROMOTION, WHICH STATED scripts/ WAS UNCHANGED: scripts/ is NOT an identical tree. It differs by three files, +849 lines - scripts/westayfit/check-evidence-intact.mjs, scripts/westayfit/route-target-coverage.mjs and scripts/westayfit/owner-board-review-copies.mjs. All three are evidence and documentation generators, reachable only through the npm scripts check:evidence, check:before-frozen, check:route-index, write:route-index and wsf:route-coverage. The two scripts this workflow actually executes - scripts/westayfit/build-staging.sh and scripts/westayfit/assert-staging-artifact.sh, at wsf-staging-deploy.yml:267-268 - are byte-identical across the range. So there is no backend or shared-infrastructure delta that reaches the deploy, which is what this promotion turns on; but the comparison is recorded as it measures rather than as it was asserted, because this file is the approval record and a reader must be able to re-derive it. The remaining delta is member application source under apps/westayfit/, its unit and end-to-end tests, and documentation and capture evidence under docs/. expectedPriorFunctions stays 46 for the same reason as the previous pin: the functions tree is unchanged from the SHA already deployed, so this deploy must create nothing.
_twelveTransportNote: SUPERSEDED READING, CORRECTED HERE. An earlier version of this note said twelve services (wsfeventcontext, wsfjointurnline, wsfturnready, wsfmyturn, wsfcompletemyturn, wsfleaveturnline, wsfcreatecombinedgoal, wsfclosecombinedgoal, wsfrepaircombinedgoal, wsfapprovestation, wsfliststations, wsfrevokestation) remained invoker_iam_check_enabled, citing run 35450108207, and concluded the expo queue path was unusable. That is WRONG as of the later run 35474881609 (run 32, 2026-09-19T23:06:35Z), whose verify receipt reads every one of those twelve as invoker_iam_check_disabled, alongside PREEXISTING_TRANSPORT_VERIFIED=22/22, NEW_SERVICE_TRANSPORT=invoker_iam_check_disabled and VERIFY=pass. The transports are open. Read from that run's own log, not carried over from a review. WHAT RUN 32 ALSO EXERCISED, which is a separate and stronger fact than transport: eight of those twelve answered at the application level in its 24-PASS turn row, called with synthetic members' own Firebase ID tokens - wsfEventContext, wsfJoinTurnLine, wsfLeaveTurnLine, wsfMyTurn, wsfTurnReady, wsfCompleteMyTurn, wsfCreateCombinedGoal and wsfApproveStation. THE OTHER FOUR ARE TRANSPORT-OPEN BUT UNEXERCISED: wsfCloseCombinedGoal, wsfRepairCombinedGoal, wsfListStations and wsfRevokeStation are not called by hosted-package-e-smoke.mjs at all, so no hosted run has established how they answer. SCOPE, AND THE LINE THIS NOTE MUST NOT CROSS: service-level acceptance is not the browser/player journey. It does not establish QR to retained activity/auth to phone-or-queue choice to ready/start to shared player to review/receipt to cleared station. That gate remains pending until 6b257c3 is actually served and one hosted player run passes. Nothing in this pin changes any transport, IAM binding or function code.
